description:
Cross-repo issue: bitty-terminal/bitty-plugins#119 (P2).

`just check` fails in linked worktrees because `.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc` ignores only the root `node_modules`, so MD012 fires on `.worktrees/<task>/node_modules/yargs/...`. Add `**/node_modules` and `.worktrees` to the ignore list, verify with a throwaway worktree fixture that carries `.worktrees/<name>/node_modules/yargs/README.md` with multiple blank lines, remove the fixture, and re-run `just check`/`just test`.
title: fix(ci): make markdownlint worktree-safe (ignore nested node_modules and .worktrees)
